primary: First fully refitted seed pair, OOF residual training; all additional seed pairs retained as full-pipeline training sensitivity, not independent events.
normalization: Each base-fold scaler and delta scaler fitted on that fold train only. Convert fold predictions back to mm before expressing them on the full-train target scale. Corrector scaler uses OOF inputs only.
early_stopping: Original external validation partition reused for all fold checkpoints, never final test. Full floating-point MAE selects checkpoints; no metric rounding before selection. This is cross-fitting with reused validation, not fully nested selection.
prior_exposure: All six TA-01 test combinations were examined during previous development. Analyses are retrospective and exploratory.
reporting: Save matched full-precision predictions, weights, OOF assignments, training histories, source hashes, all seeds and failures. Regenerate every table from these new outputs; do not copy unavailable supplementary numbers.
